notes: California's All-State choral program is the CCDA All-State Honor Choirs, run by the California Choral Directors Association (CCDA) and performed at CASMEC — the California All-State Music Education Conference, the joint conference of CMEA (the NAfME state affiliate) and its partner associations. The audition PDF describes the honor choirs as 'a collaborative effort of CCDA, SCVA, and CASMEC.' 2026-27 data was fully current at retrieval. Five All-State choirs: JH SATB, JH SSAA, HS SATB, HS SSAA, HS TTBB. Selection is two-tier for high school: students audition for a fall Regional Honor Choir (Central and Coastal regions run by CCDA; the Southern Region is run separately by SCVA at scvachoral.org), participate in the Regional Honor Choir, and then Regional Chairs send All-State consideration lists to the All-State Chairs. Junior high students audition directly by recorded upload. NOTE ON ONE FEE DISCREPANCY: the junior high audition instructions document states the audition fee as $10 in one sentence and $15 in another; the CCDA All-State page states $15, which is what is recorded here.

requirements.title: Selection via the fall Regional Honor Choirs
requirements.description: Auditions for the 2027 High School All-State Honor Choirs are done via the 2026 Regional Honor Choirs. Students who have participated in a regional high school honor choir and have indicated that they wish to be considered for All-State Honor Choir have their audition scores assessed for participation in the All-State Honor Choirs. Regional Chairs send All-State consideration lists to the All-State Chairs. Open to grades 9-12. Southern Region auditions are run separately by SCVA.

requirements.title: 100-point regional audition: solo, scales/triads, tonal memory, sight-reading
requirements.description: The HS Central/Coastal/Southern Regional Honor Choir audition is scored out of 100 points: Solo 40 points, Scales/Triads 15 points, Tonal Memory 25 points, Sight-Reading 20 points.

requirements.title: Scales and triads (15 points)
requirements.description: Sing the following, ascending and descending, on any syllable: major scale, major triad, minor triad, and chromatic scale.

requirements.title: Tonal memory (25 points)
requirements.description: Five-note passages are played on a recording for the auditionee to repeat, sung on any syllable. Past tonal memory examples are published.

requirements.title: Sight-reading (20 points)
requirements.description: A single-line, unaccompanied melody is supplied, sung on any syllable. Past sight-reading examples are published.

requirements.title: Solo must be memorized and sung with the provided accompaniment track
requirements.description: The solo (40 points) is sung from memory. Under Option 1 the auditionee sings the art song once through with no repeats or da capo, using the provided recording in a key appropriate for the voice part (Soprano/Tenor — Medium High; Alto/Bass — Medium Low); these accompaniment tracks must be used for rehearsal and audition. Under Option 2 the auditionee prepares the prescribed excerpt, measures 52 to the end of 'Sing unto God' for their voice part, from memory, using the designated accompaniment track. Learning tracks are for rehearsal purposes only and may not be used to accompany the audition.

requirements.title: Grades 6-9 with a CCDA-member director
requirements.description: Open to students in grades 6-9 whose choral directors are CCDA members. Directors' CCDA memberships must be active in order to upload auditions.

requirements.title: Recorded audition: two vocalises plus an a cappella song, one continuous track
requirements.description: Each applicant sings the ascending vocalise with the provided audition track, then the descending vocalise with the provided track, then the song a cappella (the correct pitch is given at the end of the vocalises). All three portions are recorded in one continuous track and uploaded in mp3 format to OpusEvent. Each vocalise is performed six times: the first two repetitions accompanied by piano, the remaining repetitions a cappella with a click track and chromatic cues between repetitions. The song has a suggested tempo of 78 bpm.

requirements.title: Recording rules
requirements.description: The audition must be recorded with the audition track audibly playing in the background. Enhanced recordings are disqualified. No identifying information may be given in the recording (student or director name or school); all identifying information, including file names, is hidden from judges. Practice tracks are for practice only and must not be used during the audition.

requirements.title: Published voice-part ranges and song keys
requirements.description: Soprano F4-F5 (song in B-flat Major, starting pitch F4); Alto B-flat3-B-flat4 (song in E-flat Major, starting pitch B-flat3); Tenor E-flat3-E-flat4 (song in A-flat Major, starting pitch E-flat3); Bass C3-C4 (song in F Major, starting pitch C3).

requirements.title: Submission is by the teacher, not the student
requirements.description: Teachers submit all of their students' auditions on their OpusEvent teacher account using their CCDA membership number; students do not create their own accounts. Registration requires student name and voice part, grade level, gender identity (F/M/NB), parent/guardian name, email and phone, school/organization name and address, acknowledgment of understanding of the CCDA Honor Choir handbook including All-State accommodations, and any financial assistance application. The audition fee must be paid before the audition file can be uploaded; a direct payment link can be sent to the parent/guardian.

repertoire.title: Dona Nobis Pacem
repertoire.notes: Sung a cappella as the third portion of the recorded audition; suggested tempo 78 bpm, transposed per voice part. No composer or edition is credited in the CCDA audition instructions.

fees.description: Audition fee, payable before the audition file can be uploaded. Note: the junior high audition instructions document states $10 in one sentence and $15 in another; the CCDA All-State page states $15.
